messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — service=api-inference-us-east | metric=5xx_rate | window=5m | value=5.8% | threshold=5%. Pager sent to oncall@maria. Incident ID INC-20251122-01

maria (oncall): saw it, acknowledging pager :rotating_light: joining warroom in 90s. warroom: https://meet.redwood.example/INC-20251122-01

kevin (sre): i'm on call too, joining. quick ask — is this spike affecting model streaming only or all endpoints?

maria (oncall): preliminary: both /v1/generate (stream + non-stream) show increased 5xx. embedding endpoints fine. routing to specific pool us-east-gpu-2 looks noisy.

liyah (eng): adding context: deployed kernel-selection change ~40m ago to optimize small-batch latency on that pool. might be related.

kevin (sre): ok assigning owner for mitigation: kevin (sre) — I'll own mitigation and rollback if needed. maria, pls stay as incident coordinator and handle paging/handoffs.

maria (oncall): confirmed. owner=kevin, coordinator=maria. Sofia, can you draft initial status page?

sofia (support): yep. proposed status (short): "We are investigating elevated error rates for inference requests in us-east. Impact: increased 5xx responses for text generation endpoints for a subset of customers. We will provide updates as we learn more." Want me to post as 'Investigating'?

jordan (product): post as "Investigating" now. call out region us-east and affected endpoints. include contact for enterprise customers (support@redwood).

sofia (support): draft ready, posting now to status.redwood.com (inc:INC-20251122-01).

incident-bot: Status page update created — https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-20251122-01 — current state: Investigating.

kevin (sre): mitigation plan: 1) toggle kernel-selection to previous stable commit on pool us-east-gpu-2 2) drain new connections from that pool 3) enable fallback routing to us-east-gpu-1 with degraded batching. Starting step 1 now.

liyah (eng): logs: run `kubectl logs -l pool=us-east-gpu-2 --since=15m | grep ERROR` — seeing repeated CUDA mem alloc failures + model init timeouts on a few nodes. sending exact node ids to warroom.

kevin (sre): rollback command queued: `infractl pool rollback --pool us-east-gpu-2 --to-revision v20251122-08` — running. expect 30-90s to apply, monitoring.

maria (oncall): paging confirmation to rotation: next-oncall (sre-shift) alerted. I'll update the incident channel when rollback completes.

sofia (support): customer comm template ready — short email/DM: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting inference in US-East. We're actively mitigating and will update within 30 minutes. If you see degraded behaviour, please reply to this thread or open a support ticket." Want me to send to affected customers?

jordan (product): yes, send to affected enterprise customers after first mitigation result (rollback outcome). Avoid broad blasts until we know scope.

kevin (sre): rollback completed on control plane, nodes draining. error rate dropping from 5.8% -> 1.2% in last 2m. continuing monitoring for 10m.

maria (oncall): good signal. keeping warroom open for 30m post-stabilization. plan for after-action: root cause: kernel-selection change + some node-level resource regression; next steps: revert change in canary, add extra preflight, add load-shedding when KV cache pressure high.

sofia (support): updating status page with new note: "Mitigation in progress: traffic routed away from affected pool; error rates decreasing. We'll post a resolution update once confirmed stable."

incident-bot: Incident INC-20251122-01 update — severity: P1, owner: kevin (sre), coordinator: maria (oncall), status: Monitoring after mitigation.

jordan (product): create initial postmortem template and assign to eng-ml + infra for RCA. Also schedule a 30m follow-up for SLA/customer comm decision.

maria (oncall): noted. handover plan: i'll stay until resume normal ops, then hand to next oncall with summary: cause, rollback, status page links, customer comms drafted.

kevin (sre): thanks team. if error rate climbs back above 2% i'll escalate to P1 runbook step 3 (fleet rollback + emergency capacity). For now monitoring. :white_check_mark:
